opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members who are citizens of and based in Global South countries, must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers from Global South to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK, covering travel, registration, food and accommodation.

opportunities.title: Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from all countries globally; no BES membership requirement stated.
opportunities.summary: Funding for new and innovative ecological research projects of up to £5,000, covering essential costs but not salaries or bench fees.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

amount.raw: Maximum £250 for virtual conferences, £500 for in‑person events

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members who are PhD students or postgraduate researchers; must be based at a university or research institution.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD and postgraduate researchers to attend specialist field training courses or conferences, covering registration and travel costs.

opportunities.title: Long‑term Research Grants

amount.raw: First five years’ worth of funding in year 1, £3,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members; individuals (not organisations); open to all ecologists including practitioners.
opportunities.summary: Provides a small amount of funding each year for up to 10 years to extend short‑term projects into long‑term datasets.

opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members (lead applicant); groups of 8‑15 participants with diverse composition.
opportunities.summary: Funds interdisciplinary groups to conduct data synthesis projects, covering travel, meetings, venue hire and computing costs.

opportunities.title: Outreach and Engagement Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members; open to individuals, teams or organisations; no geographic restrictions.
opportunities.summary: Supports BES members to deliver public outreach and science communication activities that engage non‑academic audiences.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development Grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members involved in teaching ecology at any level; individuals only.
opportunities.summary: Funds research into teaching and learning practices in ecology to improve educational outcomes.

opportunities.title: Connecting Ecologists with Other Disciplines Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members; PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early‑career ecologists, or employees of other organisations; undergraduates and masters students excluded.
opportunities.summary: Provides secondments for ecologists to work in a different sector or discipline for up to 12 months, fostering interdisciplinary collaboration.
